approval.scope: baseline precheck only; root approved 24 children while source remains unmodified

baseline_precheck.label: descriptive baseline precheck; not formal before/after evidence

build_binding.formal_candidate_requirement: separate target and build receipt with identical toolchain, release profile, locks, harness bytes, corpus and runtime environment; exact reviewed production diff only

formal_gate.claim_scope: only a complete fresh interleaved 48-child cohort, source/build review, and independent copied-packet replay can be evaluated; precheck is descriptive
formal_gate.generic_control: generic_read_at must remain within the predeclared control bound and pass all semantic/counter contracts; no route is selectively recaptured

primary.bootstrap_method: random.Random(seed).randrange resampling of the paired ratio vector; 10,000 medians; nearest-rank 2.5th/97.5th percentile interval
primary.pair_unit: same route and same block/position matched baseline/candidate process pair; odd blocks baseline then candidate, even blocks candidate then baseline
primary.statistic: median of paired baseline_p50/candidate_p50 ratios; ratio is baseline p50 divided by candidate p50, so >1 means candidate speedup

regression_controls.rss_threshold: flag candidate per-route maximum-RSS regression over baseline by >5%; RSS is setup-inclusive review evidence
regression_controls.semantic_or_counter_failure: any failed report/control invalidates the formal cohort; no selective recapture
regression_controls.tail_threshold: flag candidate p95 or p99 regression over baseline by >5%
regression_controls.timing: retain paired p50/p95/p99 and pooled raw latency; no adoption gate from these controls alone

formal_paired_cohort.candidate_binary: bound only after source review and matched build receipt
formal_paired_cohort.label: fresh interleaved paired cohort after candidate source/build/review freeze

metrics_and_controls.claims: baseline precheck is descriptive; no candidate adoption or speed claim until formal cohort, source review, quality gates and independent replay pass
metrics_and_controls.custody: write terminal child receipt with start/end/exit/stdout/stderr/time/report hashes before parsing; preserve every failure and never recapture
metrics_and_controls.rss: /usr/bin/time -v per child; retain maximum RSS and complete time stderr; RSS is setup-inclusive and not allocation evidence
metrics_and_controls.semantic: validate exact source/output hashes, phase conservation, source/read contracts, cache/source/sink/preservation/refusal controls, and route-specific unavailable counters
metrics_and_controls.timing: retain raw elapsed_ns vectors, per-child p50/p95/p99, pooled raw p50/p95/p99 and paired ratios only for formal cohort

purpose: fresh normal-release baseline precheck before the next candidate source edit, followed later by an interleaved paired formal cohort
reuse: reuse 0925 comparison-capture.py/comparison.py/reducer logic offline; no new capture framework or source edits in this planning step

runner.scope: external bounded precheck runner; terminal receipt is written before report parsing; no formal/adoption path

runtime.filesystem_scope: existing in-memory corpus; range_short is a bounded provider control, no disk/network claim
runtime.polling: same live process handle until terminal; observation timeout polls, confirmed deadline/nonzero/malformed/missing RSS invalidates cohort; never retries

source_binding.current_production_source_delta: none relative to the retained 0925 production closure; current worktree-only files are excluded
